parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.query: ={{ $json.is_empty ? "SELECT 1 AS skipped;" : "INSERT INTO jobs (fingerprint, source, source_job_id, company_name, company_domain, job_title, description, location, remote_type, employment_type, seniority, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, posted_at, updated_at, application_url, canonical_url, skills, technologies, raw_payload, run_id, status, match_status, telegram_sent, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) VALUES ('" + $json.fingerprint + "', '" + ($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.source_job_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.company_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.company_domain || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.job_title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.description || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.location || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.remote_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.employment_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.seniority || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', " + ($json.salary_min !== null && !isNaN($json.salary_min) ? $json.salary_min : 'NULL') + ", " + ($json.salary_max !== null && !isNaN($json.salary_max) ? $json.salary_max : 'NULL') + ", '" + ($json.salary_currency || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', " + ($json.posted_at ? "'" + $json.posted_at + "'" : 'NULL') + ", " + ($json.updated_at ? "'" + $json.updated_at + "'" : 'NULL') + ", '" + ($json.application_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + ($json.canonical_url || $json.application_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', '" + JSON.stringify($json.skills || []).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb, '" + JSON.stringify($json.technologies || []).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb, '" + JSON.stringify($json.raw_payload || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb, '" + $json.run_id + "', 'NEW', 'PENDING', FALSE, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = NOW(), run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id RETURNING id, fingerprint, source, job_title, company_name, location, remote_type, employment_type, application_url, description, skills, match_status, telegram_sent, (xmax = 0) AS is_new;" }}

={{ "UPDATE jobs SET profile_match_score = " + ($json.score || 0) + ", match_reason = '" + ($json.reasons || []).join('; ').replace(/'/g, "''") + "', match_status = '" + $json.match_status + "', match_details = '" + JSON.stringify($json.ai_details || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb WHERE fingerprint = '" + $json.fingerprint + "' RETURNING id, fingerprint, job_title, company_name, location, remote_type, employment_type, application_url, profile_match_score, match_reason, match_details, telegram_sent, '" + $json.is_qualifying + "' AS is_qualifying;" }}

={{ (($json.result && $json.result.message_id) || $json.message_id) ? "UPDATE jobs SET telegram_sent = TRUE, telegram_message_id = " + (($json.result && $json.result.message_id) || $json.message_id) + ", telegram_sent_at = NOW(), telegram_error = NULL, status = 'NOTIFIED' WHERE fingerprint = '" + ($('Format Telegram Message').item?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').last()?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').first().json.fingerprint) + "' RETURNING id, fingerprint, telegram_sent;" : "UPDATE jobs SET telegram_error = '" + (($json.error && $json.error.message) ? $json.error.message : ($json.description || 'Delivery error')).replace(/'/g, "''") + "' WHERE fingerprint = '" + ($('Format Telegram Message').item?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').last()?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').first().json.fingerprint) + "' RETURNING id, fingerprint, telegram_sent;" }}

parameters.key: ={{ 'job-search:seen:' + ($json.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').item?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').last()?.json?.fingerprint || $('Format Telegram Message').first().json.fingerprint) }}

parameters.query: ={{ "UPDATE job_runs SET completed_at = NOW(), status = 'completed', sources_succeeded = 9, jobs_fetched = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE run_id = '" + $('Initialize Run & Profile').first().json.run_id + "'), jobs_matched = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE run_id = '" + $('Initialize Run & Profile').first().json.run_id + "' AND match_status = 'MATCHED'), jobs_rejected = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE run_id = '" + $('Initialize Run & Profile').first().json.run_id + "' AND match_status = 'REJECTED'), telegram_sent = (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE run_id = '" + $('Initialize Run & Profile').first().json.run_id + "' AND telegram_sent = TRUE) WHERE run_id = '" + $('Initialize Run & Profile').first().json.run_id + "' RETURNING *;" }}
